summary: Ascentage Pharma Group International filed a Form 6-K furnishing a Hong Kong Stock Exchange voluntary announcement that its trustee bought 200,000 existing shares on-market on October 15, 2026 for the 2022 RSU Scheme. Total consideration was HK$5,778,916, averaging approximately HK$28.89 per share, about 0.05% of issued shares. The trustee now holds 2,915,000 shares and cannot exercise voting rights on them. No special-situation event, board recommendation, advisor or deal terms are stated; this is routine equity-plan administration, warranting no risk-arb angle.
